info.title: TossOS Private Operator API
info.description: Private loopback/VPN operator read API. Read resources require no application token only after the daemon validates its private network and TLS boundary. This API never exposes LIVE, gate, kill-switch, protection-weakening, or activation-manifest mutations.

servers.description: Configured private VPN or loopback TLS endpoint

tags.name: Optimization
tags.description: Server-owned finite optimization descriptors and lifecycle

tags.name: Stream
tags.description: Epoch and sequence based server-sent events

get.description: Returns the advisory engine marker projection without engine control authority. Request bodies and query parameters are rejected.

400.description: A body or query parameter was supplied to this fixed read.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are accepted.

get.description: Returns the complete server-bounded current snapshot. Every row includes the canonical fail-closed a043 exit-line projection; client filtering and pagination are intentionally unavailable.

400.description: A body or query parameter was supplied to this fixed read.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are accepted.

503.description: One or more bounded position reads are unavailable.

get.description: Returns the complete server-owned default, desired, and effective settings snapshot. This resource has no write action, filters, or pagination.

get.description: Returns the complete six-category a050 registry, owner descriptors, desired/effective state, evidence, bounded history, and bounded audit. The server fixes category order and available choices.

200.description: Canonical optimization registry and owner descriptors

get.description: Event IDs are process epoch plus monotonic sequence. Unknown epoch or a gap starts with a full snapshot. Heartbeats occur every 15 seconds; a full 64-event client queue disconnects only that client.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Last process-epoch and sequence pair. Omit it for a full snapshot.

400.description: A body or query parameter was supplied to the fixed stream.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are accepted.

503.description: The stream is unavailable or the 32-client limit is full.

post.description: The deployed daemon requires one signed one-time capability. The body accepts one to 16 exact server-registered key and option-ID pairs, never free-form values.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Single actor-and-client-scoped key. Reuse with the same canonical body replays the stored response; reuse with another body returns 409.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Single exact quoted current settings version. A stale value returns 412 and the current ETag.

requestBody.description: Finite exit-protection selection bound to the current settings version.

400.description: The JSON, idempotency key, or finite selection is invalid.

401.description: Mutation identity is missing, invalid, expired, or already consumed.

403.description: The private boundary, canonical origin, or exact capability authority was refused.

409.description: The idempotency key conflicts with another body or request in progress.

412.description: If-Match does not identify the current settings version.

415.description: Content-Type is not application/json with at most UTF-8 charset.

428.description: A single valid If-Match header is required.

503.description: The durable audit ledger or command service is unavailable.

post.description: Consumes one exact approved preview capability with actor-scoped idempotency and compare-and-swap. a051 ships an empty remote-application transition registry, so current contextual protection changes remain local-human-only and this route cannot change LIVE or protection authority.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Single exact quoted current settings version. A stale value returns 412 and the current ETag.

requestBody.description: Exact approved preview capability and explicit confirmation.

signedCapability.description: Authorization: TossOS-Capability <signed-token>. The Ed25519-signed token has a maximum 60-second lifetime, is bound to actor, client, canonical HTTPS audience, method, resource, canonical body digest, idempotency key, and If-Match, and its nonce is consumed once.

NoStore.description: Prevents storage of the private operator snapshot.

NoReferrer.description: Suppresses referrer data from the private operator API.

StreamCacheControl.description: Prevents SSE caching and proxy transformation.

KeepAlive.description: Keeps the SSE transport connection open.

NoProxyBuffering.description: Disables reverse-proxy buffering for this event stream.

StreamRetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying after the 32-client limit is reached.

VersionETag.description: Quoted settings version returned by the committed mutation result.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Single actor-and-client-scoped key. Reuse with the same canonical body replays the stored response; reuse with another body returns 409.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Single exact quoted current settings version. A stale value returns 412 and the current ETag.

Optimization.description: Canonical optimization registry and owner descriptors

MutationBadRequest.description: Mutation JSON, idempotency key, or finite command is invalid

Forbidden.description: Identity has no authority for the exact mutation

Conflict.description: Idempotency key or lifecycle state conflict

ContentTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the enforced 256 KiB maximum

JSONRequired.description: Mutation requires application/json with no parameter other than optional UTF-8 charset

PreconditionRequired.description: A single syntactically valid If-Match header is required

MethodNotAllowed.description: Method is not available on this resource

Unavailable.description: Read model is unavailable without exposing internal paths or errors

CommandUnavailable.description: Durable audit ledger or narrow optimization command is unavailable

EnvelopeBase.description: Stable metadata shared by every successful JSON resource envelope.

GenericEnvelope.description: Successful mutation envelope whose data shape is owned by the narrow optimization commander.

ErrorResponse.description: Stable fail-closed error envelope with an actionable code, request identity, and documentation anchor.

StreamEventText.description: SSE wire representation with process-epoch sequence ID, event type, and JSON data lines.

Engine.description: Read-only advisory engine marker projection; it grants no engine-control authority.

ExitLine.description: Canonical fail-closed a043 exit and protection projection attached to a position or linked order.

ReconcileBlock.description: Sanitized runtime block covering this adoption candidate. This is evidence only and carries no resolution capability.

StoredExitEvidence.description: Raw journal facts that are not an actionable effective exit line.

Position.description: Current broker and journal position joined to its exit-line evidence.

accountLabel.description: Transport-safe masked account label; never a raw account reference.

adoptionReason.description: Stable sanitized reason code from the shared position-management projector.

Positions.description: Complete server-bounded position snapshot returned without client pagination.

Order.description: Current bounded order projection; exitLine is reserved and null in a051.

Orders.description: Complete server-bounded order snapshot returned without client pagination.

Candidate.description: Current candidate verdict and its persisted evidence identity.

Candidates.description: Complete server-owned candidate snapshot returned without search or client filters.

PerformanceQuery.description: Server-owned deterministic query echoed with the performance result.

PerformanceMetric.description: One deterministic performance metric with sample state and provenance.

PerformanceAggregate.description: Policy and lane performance aggregate with explicit observation provenance.

Performance.description: Fixed-query performance result, bounded aggregates, and completeness counts.

states.description: Counts grouped by deterministic measurement state.

SettingState.description: Finite setting value or an explicit unavailable state; unapproved never implies numeric zero.

Provenance.description: Owning change, versioned policy, and evidence digests for a setting.

Setting.description: Server-owned setting descriptor with default, desired, effective, safety, and provenance state.

Settings.description: Complete settings snapshot with desired and effective version counters.

OptimizationCategory.description: One entry in the fixed six-category optimization menu, returned in registry order.

OptimizationChoice.description: Server-registered finite option rendered as a tile, select entry, chip, or discrete step.

OptimizationField.description: Finite optimization field descriptor shared with the HTML console registry.

AdoptionSettings.description: Actual desired or running-engine effective external-position adoption settings.

PositionManagementDescriptor.description: Position-management defaults and the exact 2% through 20% stop chips in 0.5% steps.

blockSource.description: Identifies the engine adoption-blocking runtime projection, not all journal causes.

CandidateFilterDescriptor.description: Read-only candidate threshold descriptor that stays unapproved until evidence is accepted.

CandidateFilterMarket.description: Server-owned candidate filter descriptors for one market and session.

RuntimeDescriptor.description: Fixed four-section strategy runtime registry with sixteen fields and nine blockers.

OptimizationEvidence.description: Completeness and freshness state for the evidence backing optimization values.

OptimizationSnapshot.description: Bounded optimization history snapshot with desired/effective digests and audit identity.

OptimizationAuditEvent.description: Immutable audit event for one finite optimization option transition.

Optimization.description: Complete fixed-category optimization registry, evidence, bounded history, and bounded audit.

OptimizationPreviewRequest.description: One to sixteen exact server-registered exit-protection selections for a current base version.

OptimizationApplyRequest.description: Exact approved preview capability plus explicit confirmation.
